description: Reviews and applies the principles, techniques and conceptual paradigms that enable humans to take advantage of computers, from the basics of calculation, to the modern pattern-finding that deep learning algorithms support. Examines both perspectives; human aspects of cognition, and the technologies that exist to support and supplement them.
supplementalNotes:

title: Computing for Cognitive Augmentation
